wiki.title: Melissa Ratcliff
wiki.extract: Melissa Amy Ratcliff (née Larsen; born November 1976) is an American Democratic politician from Cottage Grove, Wisconsin. She is a member of the Wisconsin Senate, representing Wisconsin's 16th Senate district since 2025. She previously served in the Wisconsin State Assembly, representing the 46th Assembly district during the 2023–2024 term. Before being elected to the Legislature, she served six years as a member of the Dane County Board of Supervisors and four years on the Cottage Grove village board.
